dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Is it so hard to believe?

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, sorry, I must've gotten the wrong person. Too many people ask me that, so I thought you must be an old acquaintance.

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Well, I had a short stint in the Fortress of Meropide. Petty theft and such...

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: And when I came out, no one could recognize me any longer — they said I'd changed too much.

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Well, I certainly was a leaner sight in the past — it took quite some effort just to move chairs, even. But unrecognizable, really? I just bulked up a little, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Really? Did I change so much?

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Well, I've got the Pankration Ring to thank for that, then.

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: When I first watched a boxing match, I couldn't help but wonder if I would ever have stolen, had I simply been strong enough.

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: After serving my sentence, I was invited to join the Spina, and I began to do some legitimate manual labor... I guess I'm finally on the right path, no?
